name: Taigam
description: Taigam is a scheming human monk of Tarkir, once trained by Narset, who believes dragons are Tarkir's rightful rulers.

bio.text: In the original timeline he left the Jeskai for the Sultai, pledged his life to the rakshasa Ebirri, and rose to become Sidisi's chief advisor and enforcer.

"Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

bio.text: In the altered timeline he was a rival student of Ojutai who threatened to report Narset for blasphemy, and he later confronted and ousted her, labeling her a heretic.

citations.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

bio.text: After the dragonlords fell he joined the Jeskai while secretly plotting a revival of the dragons.

citations.text: "Taigam", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: In Tarkir: Dragonstorm he urged Narset to turn Elspeth away, and he helped Sarkhan, who wanted his draconic form back, hunt a young dragon for its heart.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

bio.text: Sarkhan ate the dragon's heart and became a corrupted dragon, and Ugin returned and defeated him.

timeline.summary: Shintan reveals the orcs were hired by Taigam; the elders doubt the orcs.
timeline.quote: they had been hired by the traitor Taigam

citation.text: "Shintan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taigam's golden ship arrives at Kishla, pulled by undead sibsig, to collect the town's debt for Sidisi.
timeline.quote: A human Sultai enforcer lowered the gangplank for the leaders to enter the ship and head belowdecks.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Taigam, taught by Narset, leaves the Jeskai and travels to Purugir seeking work, drawing Sultai interest.
timeline.quote: He didn't set out to join another clan.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the rakshasa Ebirri offers Taigam power in the Sultai, and Taigam pledges his life to the rakshasa.
timeline.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Taigam rises to chief advisor of Sidisi, who sends him to enforce her decrees, watched by Ebirri.
timeline.quote: Taigam rose to chief advisor of Sidisi, the kahn of the Sultai.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Taigam humiliates an elder of Kishla, then has a guard take one of his three children.
timeline.quote: Now you have two,

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Jeskai monks kill the departing guard and burst into the ship to assassinate Taigam.
timeline.quote: Three human Jeskai monks stood with clenched fists.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ebirri fights the monks and kills two while Taigam, freeing himself, stabs the rakshasa, who then crushes a monk's head; Ebirri reminds Taigam he owns him.
timeline.quote: I own you,

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Taigam learns that Narset sent the surviving monk, has the monk crushed, and suspects the monks were zealots acting without her.
timeline.quote: They were zealots, most likely acting without her knowledge.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Taigam resolves to handle the Jeskai threat himself and has the dead monks sized for golden uniforms.
timeline.quote: Taigam signaled the sibsig to keep the boat moving as he began to size the intact dead monks for golden uniforms.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Shintan reports that an orc said Taigam hired them in revenge for an assassination attempt Narset allegedly sent; Narset denies knowing of any assassins.
timeline.quote: He said he and his kin were hired by the rat Taigam.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Taigam confronts Narset, who overpowers him and escapes; he labels her a heretic.
timeline.quote: Narset overpowered him and made her escape

citation.text: "Narset", section "New timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Master Taigam tells Sarkhan that Narset was a heretic punished to the full extent of the law and is no more.
timeline.quote: Narset is no more.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Taigam throws Sarkhan down the stairs; Sarkhan flies off in despair, resolving to wake Ugin to repair the timeline.
timeline.quote: It was time to wake the Spirit Dragon.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: At fifteen, Narset defeats Taigam in a practice match and is named Master by Ojutai, the youngest he has ever named.
timeline.quote: At fifteen, she was the youngest master Ojutai had ever named.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Taigam catches Narset and threatens to report her for blasphemy, but she blasts past him.
timeline.quote: Then let him!" Narset erupted with power, blasting past Taigam and ignoring his screams.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset becomes a master and secretly explores the Ojutai sanctuaries for the forbidden past, ignoring Taigam's warning.
timeline.quote: Her peer, Taigam, warned her of the danger in seeking out knowledge without the dragonlord's permission, but Narset saw no harm in research.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Taigam, once tempted to leave Cori Mountain, reaffirms himself to the Ojutai cause.
timeline.quote: Taigam eventually saw that only Ojutai could deliver true wisdom and reaffirmed himself to the Ojutai cause.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan awakens in the altered present, unable to revive Ugin, and finds Kolaghan, Vial Smasher, Zurgo and Taigam changed and not knowing him.
timeline.quote: He encounters the dragonlord Kolaghan

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Taigam has Sarkhan kill a dragon and eat its heart; Sarkhan becomes a massive corrupted dragon commanding a dragon army.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan killed a wild dragon and bit into its heart, transforming himself into a massive, corrupted dragon

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Desparked". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol and Taigam perform a corrupted ritual to control the wild dragons, and Ugin returns and defeats Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: Ugin returns to Tarkir, defeats Sarkhan, and puts a stop to the dragonstorm outbreak.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion and Reconstruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taigam warns that Elspeth is an omen and that her arrival may have provoked the attack, and urges Narset to send her away.
timeline.quote: Send her away, Narset. As far away from the Jeskai as it is possible,

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Taigam introduces himself to Sarkhan, claiming to have something he wants.
timeline.quote: My name is Taigam,

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, desperate to regain his draconic form, hunts a young dragon for its heart under Taigam's direction.
timeline.quote: This is how you fly with a dragon's wings once more,

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan spears the dragon and Taigam binds it with blue fire to pin it down.
timeline.quote: The blade sank through the dragon's cheek and then deeper

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan cuts out the dragon's heart, chants with Taigam, senses the spell's corruption, and bites into the heart.
timeline.quote: he bit down into the organ.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is clasped in Sarkhan's jaws while Ajani appeals to him, and Narset asks about the ritual and its sacrifice.
timeline.quote: What did you cut out of yourself to corrupt the spell?

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, encouraged by Taigam, resolves to carry out a ritual that needs a dragon's heart.
timeline.quote: With Taigam whispering encouragement in his ear, Sarkhan threw aside his misgivings.

citation.text: Sarkhan's Resolve (Tarkir: Dragonstorm, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Taigam helps Sarkhan cast a corrupted Stormnexus Ritual, giving him control of the wild dragons.
timeline.quote: Taigam helped Sarkhan cast a corrupted form of the Stormnexus Ritual

citation.text: "Dragonstorm (phenomenon)", section "Ending the outbreaks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ebirri binds himself to Taigam, teaching dark magic in exchange for his life's service.
timeline.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa

citation.text: "Ebirri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taigam rises to chief advisor of Sidisi and executes her decrees.
timeline.quote: Taigam rose to the chief advisor of Sidisi

citation.text: "Ebirri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeskai assassins attack Taigam and Ebirri emerges from the shadows.
timeline.quote: Ebirri emerged from the shadows

citation.text: "Ebirri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ebirri reminds Taigam that he owns him and kills the last monk.
timeline.quote: He reminded Taigam that he owned him

citation.text: "Ebirri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin defeated Sarkhan with ghostfire on Tarkir, ending the dragonstorm outbreak.
timeline.quote: Ugin swiftly defeated Sarkhan with ghostfire

citation.text: "Meditation Plane Breach", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taigam urges Narset to turn Elspeth away; Narset defies the council and leaves with her.
timeline.quote: Narset defied her council

citation.text: "Storm Crane Monastery", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Taigam defected from the Jeskai to the Sultai Brood.
timeline.quote: Taigam defected to the Sultai Brood to find true power

citation.text: "Taigam", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset and Shintan stopped a team of assassins sent by Taigam.
timeline.quote: they were stopped and knocked out by Narset and her bodyguard Shintan

citation.text: "Taigam", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the current timeline Taigam confronted and ousted Narset.
timeline.quote: she was eventually discovered, confronted, and ousted by Taigam

citation.text: "Taigam", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the dragonlords fell Taigam joined the Jeskai while secretly plotting a revival of the dragons.
timeline.quote: secretly plotted a revival of the dragons

citation.text: "Taigam", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taigam sought to turn Narset against Elspeth after a wild dragon attacked Storm Crane.
timeline.quote: Taigam took this opportunity to turn Narset against Elspeth.

citation.text: "Taigam", section "Dragonstorms". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taigam offered to help Sarkhan regain his power by killing a dragon and eating its heart.
timeline.quote: offered to help him regain the power he had lost in the Desparkening

citation.text: "Taigam", section "Dragonstorms". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan ate a dragon's heart and became a corrupted dragon, driving wild dragons into a frenzy until Ugin returned.
timeline.quote: He transformed into a massive, corrupted dragon

citation.text: "Taigam", section "Dragonstorms". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Narset trained Taigam when he was Jeskai.
